---
title: "The Future of Electric Vehicles and Technology Leadership"
description: "How China's rise to 30% of global EV exports has triggered US and EU tariffs, and what that means for the industry as growth slows."
date: "2024-10-08"
categories: [firms, trade-wars]
---

The global electric vehicle market has been transformed between 2020 and
2024, with China rising to control around 30% of EV exports on the back of
cost advantages and state subsidies, while Germany holds its ground at the
high end of the market. That rise has provoked a sharp trade-policy response,
with the US and EU imposing substantial tariffs on Chinese EVs in response to
the subsidies underpinning their export growth. As the market matures after a
period of explosive growth, the piece argues that success will increasingly
hinge on how governments balance protectionism against fair competition while
still pursuing decarbonisation through coordinated global strategy.

**Originally published on Substack**, October 8, 2024.
